title: Shared habits with people close to you
description: A shared habit for a couple or for friends. The participants choose which check-ins to show each other and how to keep the shared plan going.

blocks.text: A friend sees that the habit was completed, and for some people that helps them keep to what was agreed. But shared access doesn’t have to turn into a competition. Someone may find it comfortable to share one habit and keep the rest private.

quote.text: I added my friend who is also doing the same thing and it made us take even more accountability because we can see if one of us didn’t finish a specific habit.

blocks.text: Offer to invite someone they know to a chosen habit and to agree on what exactly is visible. Allow a short reaction or a message of support, and a way to pause taking part for a while. Don’t show the other records automatically.

Follow a single shared agreement all the way through, including a miss and a change of schedule. Does the visibility help people carry on, or does it create unwanted pressure? That answer matters more than the number of reactions and the time spent in the feed.
